national_news.title: Centre Announces High-Level Committee on Gorkha Issue and Plans Triangular Security Grid
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah announced the formation of a high-level committee chaired by Interlocutor Pankaj Singh (former BSF Director and Deputy NSA) to address issues in the Darjeeling Hills, Terai, and Dooars within the constitutional framework.

A high-level security meeting was conducted at Sukna in Siliguri to review border surveillance along the strategic Siliguri Corridor ('Chicken's Neck'), the key land link connecting the Northeast with the rest of India.

Discussions focused on creating a 'Triangular Security Grid' to strengthen coordination among central security forces (BSF, SSB), intelligence agencies, and state police near the international borders with Nepal, Bhutan, and Bangladesh.

national_news.title: BRICS Youth Ministers Adopt Joint Statement at Visakhapatnam Summit
bullets: The BRICS Youth Ministers' Meeting concluded in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, presided over by Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya.
The meeting concluded with the adoption of a Joint Statement focusing on youth cooperation across education, skills, entrepreneurship, science and technology, and sustainability.
India showcased its 'MY Bharat' (Mera Yuva Bharat) platform as a one-stop portal for youth engagement, highlighting that over 25 million young people have registered on it.

national_news.title: 14th BRICS STI Ministerial Meeting Held in Chennai Under India's Presidency
bullets: Union Minister of State for Science and Technology Dr. Jitendra Singh addressed the 14th BRICS Science, Technology, and Innovation (STI) Ministerial Meeting in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
The official theme for India's BRICS Presidency 2026 in STI is 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.

India called for deeper cooperation in frontier technologies (AI, Quantum, Biotechnology, Photonics) and highlighted national initiatives including the National Quantum Mission, National Supercomputing Mission, and BioE3 Policy.

national_news.title: PM Modi Highlights Roadmap for Next-Generation Governance and Economic Reforms
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the World Leaders Forum in New Delhi, stating that economic and governance reforms are a commitment and conviction for his administration.
Highlighted the transition from a restrictive regulatory approach to modern policy frameworks like the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme to generate employment and drive growth.
Noted that the International Monetary Fund (IMF) projects India to remain the world's fastest-growing major economy despite global macroeconomic uncertainties.

national_news.title: Union Home Minister Reviews Border Fencing and Security Grid for Siliguri Corridor
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah underscored the urgency of completing border fencing along the India-Bangladesh border to strengthen national security and curb illegal infiltration.

Announced a triangular security grid involving Army posts in Chopra (West Bengal), Dhubri (Assam), and Kishanganj (Bihar) to safeguard the strategically sensitive Siliguri Corridor ('Chicken's Neck').
Laid foundation stones for SSB infrastructure projects valued at ₹189 crore in Siliguri and reviewed the full rollout of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).

national_news.title: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand Assure Medal at BWF Badminton World Championships
bullets: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand reached the semifinals of the BWF Badminton World Championships held at Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, New Delhi.
They became only the second Indian women's doubles pair to win a World Championship medal, following Jwala Gutta and Ashwini Ponnappa's bronze in 2011.
The duo secured their spot by defeating China's fourth seeds Jia Yi Fan and Zhang Shu Xian in the quarterfinals.

national_news.title: PM Modi Interacts with Founders and CEOs of 20 Space Startups in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi interacted with CEOs and founders of 20 space startups in New Delhi, including Skyroot Aerospace, Agnikul Cosmos, Pixxel, and Digantara.
Encouraged the space sector to expand applications of space technology into agriculture, livestock management, dairy, and environmental monitoring.
Advocated for greater collaboration between space private enterprises and Atal Tinkering Labs to foster scientific interest among young students.

national_news.title: Indian Doubles Pairs Progress at BWF World Championships 2026
bullets: The Indian men's doubles pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty advanced to the quarterfinals of the BWF World Championships 2026 in New Delhi.
Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand reached the women's doubles quarterfinals by defeating seventh-seeded Japanese pair Rin Iwanaga and Kie Nakanishi.
Former World Champion PV Sindhu, Ayush Shetty, and the mixed doubles pair of Dhruv Kapila and Tanisha Crasto ended their runs in the pre-quarterfinals.

national_news.title: Legendary Odia Playback Singer Pranab Patnaik Passes Away at 88
bullets: Renowned Odia playback singer Pranab Patnaik passed away in Bhubaneswar at the age of 88.
He began his playback singing journey in 1958 and sang in over 200 films, spanning genres like folk, Odissi, devotional, and semi-classical music.
Patnaik was a seven-time Odisha State Film Award winner and a recipient of the prestigious Jayadev Puraskar for his outstanding contribution to Odia cinema.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Clarifies ₹4 Lakh Limit Under Student Credit Card Scheme
bullets: The Bihar government clarified that higher education loans up to ₹4 lakh will continue to be made available under the Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme.
Under the revised mechanism, the Bihar State Education Finance Corporation will extend loans up to ₹2 lakh, while scheduled commercial banks will provide the remaining amount up to ₹4 lakh.
The scheme has been linked with the PM Vidyalaxmi portal and PM Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana, with expenditure approval raised to ₹950 crore for 2026-27.

bihar_news.title: Union Govt Sanctions ₹13,427 Crore for 11.19 Lakh PMAY Houses in Bihar
bullets: Union Rural Development Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan approved 11,18,937 pucca houses for Bihar under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) with a financial outlay of ₹13,427 crore.
Over the last two years, a cumulative total of 24,30,327 houses involving an expenditure of ₹29,164 crore have been sanctioned for the state.
The announcement also featured the implementation of Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) in Bihar and the creation of district-level 'She-Marts' to promote Jeevika Self-Help Group products.

bihar_news.title: 100 Acres Identified for Proposed Sugar Mill in Pirpainti, Bihar
bullets: The Bhagalpur district administration identified 100 acres of land in Pirpainti to set up a proposed modern sugar mill.
A detailed site report has been submitted by District Magistrate Alankrita Pandey to Bihar's Sugarcane Development Department for departmental approval.
Pirpainti accounts for the largest area under sugarcane cultivation in Bhagalpur district, alongside Nathnagar and Sultanganj blocks.
